social:piasnews-social-6cc5a37e5c91c2d8:.source_text: "a podium or win would be nice, but trying to find more answers, keep working on those things, that's the biggest thing for the rest of the year. next year i'm confident we can be back fighting for both championships. i want to learn as much as i can to be prepared for that." https://t.co/7qlPoSJMa1
social:piasnews-social-6cc5a37e5c91c2d8:.zh: “登上领奖台或夺冠当然很好，但更重要的是努力寻找更多答案，继续在这些方面下功夫，这是今年剩余时间里最重要的事。明年我有信心我们能回来为两个冠军而战。我想尽可能多地学习，为此做好准备。”

social:piasnews-social-ec6988f8543555d4:.source_text: on the impact tyres have on the mcl40: "softs are very good this year, races are much closer to a qualifying driving style, everything points towards having to drive more aggressively. trying to tread that line is very difficult. we'll find out next year if it's mcl-specific." https://t.co/DCH6vwyXoF
social:piasnews-social-ec6988f8543555d4:.zh: 关于轮胎对 mcl40 的影响：“今年软胎非常好，比赛中的驾驶风格更接近排位赛，一切都指向必须开得更激进。要把握那条界线非常困难。明年我们就会知道这是不是 mcl 特有的问题。”

social:piasnews-social-a21d656dc76de60a:.source_text: "both lando and i are struggling with a car that's very sensitive to a lot of things. the way to drive it is quite specific, and quite a narrow window. when you've got more things outside of that that make it tricky, like bumps or windy conditions, it only adds to the challenge." https://t.co/Q2AHqPIydN
social:piasnews-social-a21d656dc76de60a:.zh: “lando 和我都在与一辆对很多因素都非常敏感的赛车较劲。驾驶它的方式相当特殊，窗口也很窄。当有更多超出这个窗口的因素让它变得棘手时，比如颠簸或大风天气，只会让挑战更大。”

social:piasnews-social-990ad1531e7cdab6:.source_text: on the setbacks in austin: "austin was a step back, but sometimes you need to take two steps forward and one step back to find your feet. the triple header before austin was a very good step in the right direction, but there's still room to go." https://t.co/Qohs9gH1cE
social:piasnews-social-990ad1531e7cdab6:.zh: 关于奥斯汀的挫折：“奥斯汀是一次退步，但有时你需要前进两步、后退一步才能站稳脚跟。奥斯汀之前的三连赛是朝着正确方向迈出的非常好的一步，但仍有提升空间。”

social:piasnews-social-9e86ae5f9d0c596f:.source_text: oscar on adapting to the new reg cars: "i definitely have to drive a lot differently now. it's been a challenge, but i think we'll find a way. we have to find a way in the next few months. hopefully not years, but there's fundamental aspects of these cars that won't change." https://t.co/2tHIoiNyFb
social:piasnews-social-9e86ae5f9d0c596f:.zh: Oscar谈适应新规则赛车：“我现在肯定得用很不一样的方式驾驶。这很有挑战性，但我觉得我们会找到办法。我们必须在接下来几个月里找到办法。希望不是几年，但这些赛车有一些根本性的方面不会改变。”

social:piasnews-social-024d7e9eee2c1fe5:.source_text: "how different do you expect the power unit to be with the altitude in mexico?" oscar: "we don't know yet 😀 i don't think anyone knows 😃 it's definitely not gonna be better 😁" AWESOME 😭😭😭 https://t.co/Mo5ypggLmJ
social:piasnews-social-024d7e9eee2c1fe5:.zh: “考虑到墨西哥的海拔，你觉得动力单元会有多大不同？”Oscar：“我们还不知道😀 我觉得没人知道😃 肯定不会更好😁”太棒了😭😭😭

social:piasnews-social-59aea1843217391b:.source_text: "is it a battle to get this car in the right window?" oscar: "definitely 😂 we've got some answers, not all of them. we've got a pretty good idea, certainly a direction, of why things weren't as smooth as we hoped. a lot of them are things i can keep working on this weekend." https://t.co/gT4SADIuXV
social:piasnews-social-59aea1843217391b:.zh: “让这辆车进入正确的工作窗口是一场战斗吗？”Oscar：“绝对是😂 我们找到了一些答案，但不是全部。我们对为什么事情没有我们希望的那样顺利有了相当不错的想法，至少有了方向。其中很多是我这个周末可以继续努力的事情。”

social:piasnews-social-0a25ee487ec14b9e:.source_text: on staying ahead of redbull while the car is so difficult to drive: "you just have to keep fighting. we know we're not as competitive as redbull but we're adding performance to the car and a lot of things can happen. it's gonna be a big challenge but we're always up for it." ☺️ https://t.co/nXJVtlh5dl
social:piasnews-social-0a25ee487ec14b9e:.zh: 关于在赛车如此难驾驶的情况下保持领先Red Bull：“你只能继续战斗。我们知道我们不如Red Bull有竞争力，但我们正在为赛车增加性能，很多事情都可能发生。这将是一个巨大的挑战，但我们总是迎难而上。”☺️

social:piasnews-social-f71848fa2456a994:.source_text: oscar on staying motivated this year 👏🏻 "everything is learning for next year. hopefully we can come out with a car capable of fighting for a championship. i want to go into next year with as many answers and tools in my arsenal as i can. that's my big motivation." https://t.co/8B0aCVkuI1
social:piasnews-social-f71848fa2456a994:.zh: Oscar谈今年如何保持动力👏🏻 “一切都是为了明年的学习。希望我们能拿出一辆有能力争夺冠军的赛车。我想带着尽可能多的答案和工具进入明年。这是我最大的动力。”

social:piasnews-social-2895148dc9e3150f:.source_text: Q: Do you have an idea of what you want to work on in the winter? "In some ways, yes.
